composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-120a "MAST/EXTERIOR LIGHTS & SWITCHES") is fed from the FWD DC DISTRIBUTION PANEL and serves: MAST LIGHTS (Q11), BOOM LIGHTS (Q12), FWD DC SOCKETS/ANCHOR BAY DC SOCKETS (Q13), FOG HORN (Q14), and EMERGENCY LTS SUPPLY (QE1) via T/S E/F. It also carries a HYDRAULICS EMERGENCY STOP signal block (DO22-CH07/MYT 0V/DIO3-CH13/MYT 24V) that is monitoring/estop wiring for the MYT hydraulics system, and terminal blocks A/B/C/D that break out the mast-head/boom/deck light circuits and DC MAST SOCKETS by name. The register maps MAST LTS -> 690-lts-mast, BOOM LTS -> 690-lts-boom, DECK LTS -> 690-lts-deck, DC SOCKETS -> 692-dc-sockets, FOG HORN -> 733-fog-horn, EMERGENCY LTS -> 693-emergency-lighting, HYDRAULICS -> 570-myt-systems-hydraulics, NAVIGATION LTS -> 690-lts-navigation (for the nav-mode lamps upper/lower red + green + steaming/anchor which are navigation-mode running lights per the mast-light legend group A/C). Spreader/aft-boom/cockpit-boom lamps in group B belong to boom/mast lighting per their names.

facts: Panel houses breakers QE1 (10A, Emergency Lts Supply), Q11 (10A, Mast Lights), Q12 (6A, Boom Lights), Q13 (16A, FWD DC Sockets), Q14 (16A, Fog Horn), supplied from +24V SERVICE SUPPLY through F5 100A fuse.
Relay bank Re7-Re19 and terminal strips T/S E, T/S F (terminals 25-91) form the internal wiring/distribution backbone for this panel's outgoing circuits — not equipment in themselves.
Multi-core cables MU4-12 (to DWG120/112/111a), MU5-12 (to AFT DC PANEL), MU6-12 (to LAZ. J/BOX 2), MU5a-12 (to AFT DC PANEL) carry these circuits off-sheet.
